purpose: Required input contract for E6b paired Development generation; this file is not an experimental result or a model input.
requirements: Exactly one ranked top-40, hydrated candidate list for every active Development v2 task from a single frozen retrieval run; raw top-8 is control and source-aware top-8 is candidate.

Each selected chunk retains non-empty evidence text, anchor ID, source version and page; the exporter verifies anchor/source/page/split against frozen ground truth, and visual/OCR evidence additionally retains an in-root artifact path and SHA-256.

Architecture visual-flow and planning-scan tasks require a verified visual/OCR artifact in both arms. The trace records retrieval run ID, Git commit and corpus-lock SHA-256; the CLI verifies that hash against the supplied frozen corpus lock and rejects task gaps, out-of-scope sources, malformed artifacts and a changed-task rate below 20%.
Only after the exporter has produced paired contexts may prompts, a model request manifest and E6b/E7 Development calls be frozen.
